description: This file contains the PHP class 'Reward' within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account' namespace. The class manages customer reward points, including adding, deleting, and retrieving reward data. It interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to customer rewards.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: A model class that handles customer reward points, including adding rewards, deleting rewards, and fetching reward data like totals and lists.

methods.name: addReward
methods.description: Inserts a new reward record for a customer based on an order, description, and points.

methods.name: deleteReward
methods.description: Deletes reward records for a customer, optionally filtered by order ID.

methods.name: deleteRewardByOrderId
methods.description: Deletes reward records associated with a specific order ID where points are negative.

methods.name: getRewards
methods.description: Retrieves a list of reward records for a customer, with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalRewards
methods.description: Returns the total number of reward records for a customer.

methods.name: getRewardTotal
methods.description: Calculates and returns the sum of reward points for a customer.
